title: Effective shadowing of transition maps for a Hamiltonian saddle-center-center equilibrium
summary: We introduce a general methodology to construct globally unstable trajectories near the normally hyperbolic invariant manifold (NHIM) of a saddle-center-center Hamiltonian equilibrium. The proposed approach builds upon the classical geometric mechanism of searching for trajectories near heteroclinic connections between invariant tori of the NHIM. The main ingredient is the Birkhoff normal form near the NHIM, which allows us to control the dynamics of the hyperbolic and center components.
